Additional XYZ and XYZW destinations retain projection-space xyz / xyzw (no viewport divide), while XYZRHW uses viewport xyz and reciprocalw. CLIPPING updates status for all three forms; existing ClipUnion accumulates OR and ClipIntersection accumulates AND (initial5/4 plus a right-clipped vertex produced7/0). User clip plane0 contributes SDK D3DCS_PLANE0=40h. DONOTCOPYDATA also preserved diffuse/UV bytes with ambient lighting enabled, so observed behavior is position-only writes for that flag. Half-channel ambient/color boundary values producedARGB01010203, supporting half-up normalized color conversion in these cases. October 2, 2026 additional scoped native API evidence: NativeProcessVerticesProbe --lighting completed 96 successful software-vertex-processing cases on Parallels prl_umdd.dll 001400120A8CE504. Inputs XYZ/NORMAL/DIFFUSE/SPECULAR; outputs XYZRHW/DIFFUSE/SPECULAR; point/spot/directional lights at sparse API indices 201..203; NORMALIZENORMALS, nonuniform world scale, SPECULARENABLE, LOCALVIEWER and DONOTCOPYDATA varied. Nonunit-normal diffuse/specular values and subunit attenuation denominators show that intermediate terms are not universally clamped to [0,1]. Sampled spot results exceed the corresponding point-light output inside the inner cone; hypothesis being verified in DX11 is an unclamped-above-one cone ratio before falloff. Matrix varies NONE/EXP/EXP2/LINEAR vertex mode, NONE/LINEAR table mode, range flag, FOGENABLE, ambient lighting, DONOTCOPYDATA, plus equal/reversed start/end and zero density. Inputs use nonidentity world/view/projection. Enabled non-NONE vertex fog changes specular alpha even when table mode is LINEAR; table mode did not alter these outputs. Disabled fog preserves the normal copied/generated specular alpha. Range fog uses view-position length; exponential non-range rows agree with abs(view-space Z), not projected Z. Equal linear start/end produced alpha zero for every tested vertex; reversed range is not clamped to a positive denominator. No-copy preserved both destination color DWORDs, including fog alpha. 2026-10-02 scoped host D3D9 contract evidence, stage-owned-texture-lod/native.log (not a claim of an Oblivion call-site execution): 44 successful 2D/cube/volume creation cases, 396 SetLOD/GetLOD observations. MANAGED ordinary resources clamp requested DWORD to public visible GetLevelCount-1 and return the previous value. DEFAULT/SYSTEMMEM/SCRATCH ignore writes and return/read zero. MANAGED AUTOGEN 2D/cube expose one level and clamp to zero, not hidden generated mips. After failed Reset with live DEFAULT resource: GetLOD and SetLOD return zero; requested write is ignored; successful Reset restores prior managed LOD2. Native volume AUTOGEN creation rejected. This is host-provider measurement, not universal capability proof. Owned replacement source/validation status is recorded separately.

2026-10-02 source milestone: owned public SetLOD/GetLOD now maintain atomic CPU state and publish changed controls to DX11 SRVs; no-op exchanges preserve revision. Original per-object GetLOD is used only for bootstrap inspection to avoid hook recursion; public foreign resources retain original routing. Release renderer build and four targeted checks passed: 396 native LOD observations, worker calls and 2D/cube/volume SRV mip selection with zero native LOD calls, alias reinspection, failed-Reset recovery, 193 manager checks, 109 inspection checks and 45 mip-reference comparisons (max channel error1). Undeployed; V233 remains installed. Native texture COM allocation/filter/bootstrap metadata remain dependencies. Evidence stage-owned-texture-lod.

2026-10-02 source stage-owned-texture-dirty: owned AddDirtyRect/AddDirtyBox now validate/copy caller arguments and atomically update owned dirty metadata without native control calls. Release renderer and2 targeted checks passed:1872native result comparisons plus exact DX11 2D/cube/volume partial-transfer pixels, held-lock, invalid-pointer and Reset cases; manager199checks. Test exposed a real reset-publication bug also affecting new LOD/filter setters: CPU control commits must succeed while GPU replay is already pending, keeping publicationLost set until Runtime Lookup replays latest controls/data. Fix preserves the replay fence; it does not authorize stale GPU data. Recovery test proves filter/dirty CPU commits then actual DX11 replay; LOD value/replay-fence preservation also checked. Initial test-only whole-region normalization mismatch corrected separately. No deployment. Native texture COM allocation/bootstrap and GDI remain dependencies; no general backend-completion/suppression claim.

POINT/LINEAR setters succeed even on ordinary non-AUTOGEN textures. ANISOTROPIC succeeds on 2D but rejects on cube/volume (reported filter caps 03030700/03030300/03030300). NONE and enum values4..8/99/FFFFFFFF reject without changing the stored filter. Initial filter is LINEAR except SCRATCH cube returns NONE on this provider. Failed Reset makes getter return NONE and valid/invalid setters return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL; a successful Reset restores prior managed POINT state. 2026-10-02 contract clarification: Microsoft SetAutoGenFilterType documentation requires the corresponding D3DPTFILTERCAPS_MINFxxx bit; source admission uses cached per-kind device caps. Migration deliberately follows the measured provider behavior here, retains bootstrap initial filter (including SCRATCH cube NONE), and records this divergence rather than asserting universal behavior. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/d3d9/nf-d3d9-idirect3dbasetexture9-setautogenfiltertype and corresponding getautogenfiltertype. GetFunction with physically sufficient output storage returned S_OK/full exact bytecode/intact following guard for incoming sizes 0,1,required-1,required,required+4,UINT_MAX (72 reads).
